prerequisite: independent APPROVE of the exact new dry_run digest, then host-gated deploy and FETCH hash verification
action: one IndexNow GET submission of the root URL using the included key file (same method as L40/L44)

metrics.submission_receipt: HTTP status of the single IndexNow GET (202 = received only)
metrics.indexing: unknown unless a public search observation shows the URL; not inferred from 202
metrics.requests: commercial_feedback counts (REQUEST/EXPLICIT_INTEREST), aggregate only, attribution uncertain
metrics.delivery: free self-service download; no download telemetry exists, so downloads stay UNKNOWN
metrics.revenue: none possible: no collection route (blocker SERVICE-PAYMENT-COLLECTION)

stop_rule: no further Shopify building unless a classified request appears; missing telemetry is unknown, not zero
